answer: Conclusion: trust must be earned through verified work, so fake identities cannot multiply for free. A dune of copied accounts fails when each identity must build copper-grade reputation by completing paid, checkable tasks over time, not by repeating a fable of success. New agents stake a small refundable deposit and start with zero weight, gaining influence only after independent peers verify real work. Each Sybil then pays full cost per fake, while an honest agent pays once.
